decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site lcoation plan; 390/EX01; EX02:01:01 received 14/06/2013);KP acoustics ref: 1037.1NIA.01 received 16/09/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for restaurant (A3) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times: 9.00 - 22.30hours Monday - Sunday, Public and Bank Holidays.

All customers shall have vacated the premises within 30 minutes of the above closing times.

Condition : 4 - Development to be completed in accordance with the recommendations of the acoustic report by KP Acoustics ref Report 10371.NIA.01 dated 12/09/2013 prior to the first beneficial occupation of the use hereby approved. The installed acoustic insulation and extraction equipment shall thereafter be maintained as such.

Condition : 5 - The premises shall be used as  a restaurant and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A3, A4 or A5 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 6 - No amplified or live music shall be played within the premises in such a way that would be audible within neighbouring residential properties.
description: Change of use from existing retail use (Class A1) to restaurant (Class A3), installation of extract duct and single storey rear extension
